---
title: "Stemming: Finn the Wolfhound"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(SnowballC)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
load(here("data/finn_clean.rda"))

```




```{r}
wordStem(c("win", "winning", "winner"))
wordStem(c("call", "calling", "called"))
```
```{r}
getStemLanguages()
```

```{r}
finn_stemmed |> 
  mutate(word_stemmed = wordStem(word, language = "english")) -> finn_clean

# Save the updated dataset so it includes our new stemmed words!
save(finn_clean, file = here("data/finn_clean.rda"))
```
```{r}
finn_clean |> count(word_stemmed, sort = TRUE) |>
  filter(n > 150) |>
  mutate(word_stemmed = reorder(word_stemmed, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(n, word_stemmed)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Top Stemmed Words in Finn the Wolfhound",
       y = NULL, x = "Count")
```

```{r}
finn_clean |> count(word, sort = TRUE) |>
  filter(n > 150) |>
  mutate(word = reorder(word, n)) |>
      
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = word)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Top Original Words in Finn the Wolfhound",
       y = NULL, x = "Count")
```


## addition visiluzations 
```{r}
# Plot 1: Stemmed Words
finn_stemmed |> 
  count(word_stemmed, sort = TRUE) |>
  filter(n > 150) |>
  mutate(word_stemmed = reorder(word_stemmed, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = word_stemmed)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Top Stemmed Words in Finn the Wolfhound",
       y = NULL, x = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# Plot 2: Original Unstemmed Words
finn_stemmed |> 
  count(word, sort = TRUE) |>
  filter(n > 150) |>
  mutate(word = reorder(word, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = word)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Top Original Words in Finn the Wolfhound",
       y = NULL, x = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
